Contributing to rzig

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

rzig generates the native boundary between R and Zig, so a change can affect every package that uses it. The repository therefore checks each change at several levels, and a pull request is expected to pass all of them.

Setting up

  • R 4.6 or newer with the build tools of your platform.
  • Zig 0.16.0 and 0.17.0 (both series are supported; rzig::install_zig() installs a verified release).
  • The R packages in Suggests of DESCRIPTION.

Where things live

  • src/ is the Zig framework. sh tools/sync_fixture.sh and sh tools/sync_r_package_assets.sh copy it into the test fixture, the example package and inst/zig/framework; zig build gen regenerates the generated Zig files. Edit src/, never the copies.
  • R/ is the R package: scanning, rendering, checks, the build and the helpers. inst/templates and inst/zig are the templates that use_rzig() copies into packages.
  • tests/fixtures/rzigtest is an R package that exercises the boundary; examples/rzigcausal is an example package built in CI.

Checks before a pull request

zig build test            # Zig unit tests, with Zig 0.16 and 0.17
zig build lint            # the one-error-exit and jump-resume rules
sh tools/sync_fixture.sh --check
# with Zig 0.16, whose format is the format of record
zig fmt --check build.zig src tools tests/fixtures/rzigtest/src/rzig examples/rzigcausal/src/rzig
devtools::test()          # with NOT_CRAN=true; builds packages when Zig is present
devtools::check()

The fixture tests run in an installed copy of tests/fixtures/rzigtest (see .github/workflows/ci.yml for the commands), and Rscript tools/gctorture_run.R tests/gctorture-callbacks.R runs the boundary under gctorture().

Rules for the boundary

  • Zig code returns errors; only src/boundary.zig raises R errors, after every Zig resource has been released (zig build lint enforces it).
  • R code runs only on the thread that entered R, and R’s jumps out of R code that Zig calls are stopped before the Zig frames (src/rcall.zig).
  • Every R API symbol that src/c/abi.zig declares must be part of R’s API (Rscript tools/check_api_symbols.R).
  • A change that affects packages gets a NEWS entry, and a change of a template keeps update_rzig() working (Rscript tools/known_template_hashes.R).

Reporting problems

Please use the issue templates: a bug report names the versions of R, rzig and Zig and the platform, and includes rzig::rzig_status(path) of the package and a minimal Zig function that shows the problem.
